_about: Did they improve? Dated roster amendments to the plan's section 3 (the plan file and its sha256 unchanged): each added chat model joins the plan's models for validation and the results table (improve_page.read_plan). The harness records the same amendment in improve.json ('amendments', never read); this file is what the page shows. A model is listed once its setup's settings are in v3.db (the harness exports it from then on).

amendments.note: Added 12 Nov, after the plan was published: the Tiny and Small chat models tested on Logic & Math, each at its highest reasoning setting, under the same rule, lesson prompt, test and schedule. Listed here once the setup's settings are in the league database; Gemma 4 E2B, Gemma 4 12B, Erk-14B and Qwen3-14B follow when theirs are.
